easy.def: To take hold of something fast.
examples: Grab my hand.
He grabbed the ball.
I grabbed my coat.

more.def: To take hold of something quickly and firmly.
examples: She grabbed the rope and pulled herself up.
Grab your coat because it is cold out.
The bear grabbed a fish out of the stream.
A grand castle.
The grand hall.
It was a grand party.
The king lived in a grand castle.
They held a grand party for the whole town.
The theater has a grand staircase.
I am grateful for my family.
I am grateful for your help.
We are grateful for the sunny day.

more.def: Feeling or showing thanks for something good.
examples: We were grateful to the neighbors who helped us move.
The lost hikers were grateful to see the rescue team.
She wrote a note to say how grateful she was for the gift.

easy.def: What pulls things down to the ground.
examples: Gravity makes the ball fall down.
Gravity keeps us on the ground.
Without gravity, we would float.

more.def: The force that pulls objects toward the Earth and keeps us on the ground.
examples: Because of gravity, a dropped pencil always falls to the floor.
Gravity pulls the rain down from the clouds.
There is less gravity on the moon than on Earth.
We had a great day.
That is a great idea.
She is a great singer.

more.def: Very good, or much larger or more important than usual.
examples: Our team had a great game and won by a lot.
The Great Wall is one of the longest walls in the world.
A great storm blew across the plains.
The greedy boy took all the cookies.
Do not be greedy. Take just one.
The greedy dog ate the cat's food too.

more.def: Wanting much more of something than you need or than is fair.
examples: The greedy king kept all the gold for himself.
The greedy pirate wanted all the treasure for himself.
It would be greedy to take more than your share.
Grass is green.
A green frog sat there.
She wore a green coat.

more.def: Having the color of grass or leaves.
examples: Frogs are often green.
The green leaves danced in the wind.
He painted the fence green.
Green is my favorite color.
Mix blue and yellow to make green.
The leaves are a bright green.

more.def: The color of fresh leaves and grass.
examples: The artist used many shades of green.
Spring turns the fields to green.
Green looks bright on a sunny day.

easy.def: The earth that you walk on.
examples: The ground is wet.
Sit on the ground.
The apple fell to the ground.

more.def: The solid surface of the Earth that you stand and walk on.
examples: Snow covered the ground.
The ground shook when the truck passed.
She planted the seeds in the soft ground.
A group of kids played.
A group of ducks swam by.
We sat in a group.

more.def: A number of people, animals or things that are together.
examples: A group of students waited for the bus.
A group of whales swam past the boat.
Sort the shapes into three groups.

easy.def: To put things together in sets.
examples: Group the toys by color.
She grouped the cards.
We grouped the blocks.

more.def: To put people or things together into sets.
examples: Group the buttons by color.
The teacher grouped us in pairs.
She grouped the animals by where they live.
Plants grow in the sun.
My baby brother grows fast.
The puppy grew bigger.

more.def: To become bigger or taller as time passes.
examples: Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up.
The town grew as more families moved in.
My hair has grown a lot since last spring.

easy.def: To plant something and take care of it.
examples: We grow tomatoes in our garden.
Farmers grow corn.
She grew beans in a cup.

more.def: To plant seeds or young plants and take care of them until they are ready.
examples: Grandpa grows vegetables behind his house.
Farmers in this valley grow apples and pears.
We grew sunflowers for the school fair.

easy.def: To slowly become a certain way.
examples: It grows dark early in winter.
She grew tired of waiting.
He grew sleepy in the car.

more.def: To slowly change until something is a certain way.
examples: The sky grew dark as the storm came closer.
The puppy grew sleepy after its walk.
As the music grew louder, the crowd began to clap.
I am grumpy when I am tired.
The grumpy man did not smile.
My cat is grumpy after a bath.

more.def: Easily annoyed and in a bad mood.
examples: He is always grumpy before he has eaten breakfast.
The grumpy troll would not let anyone cross the bridge.
She felt grumpy because she had slept badly.
